triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER stock_movement_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON "StockMovement" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_stock_movement_mutation()

triggers.name: user_auth_version_changed_notify
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER user_auth_version_changed_notify AFTER UPDATE OF "authVersion" ON "User" FOR EACH ROW WHEN (old."authVersion" IS DISTINCT FROM new."authVersion") EXECUTE FUNCTION notify_user_auth_version_changed()
